subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: MEMS: Machines on a Chip
description: Learn MEMS: Machines on a Chip in one minute.

hook.text: Your phone knows which way it's tilted. A tiny machine inside tells it.

buildup.text: MEMS — micro-electro-mechanical systems — are gears and levers on a silicon chip.

discovery.text: Accelerometers, gyroscopes, and pressure sensors all fit on a grain of sand.

twist.text: MEMS are etched with the same process that makes computer chips. Billions exist.

climax.text: Cars, phones, drones, and medical devices all depend on MEMS sensors.

punchline.text: Machines shrank until they fit inside a phone.

quiz.question: How are MEMS devices manufactured?
options: Tiny robots assemble them under microscopes
They're etched from silicon using the same processes as computer chips
3-D printers build them layer by layer from metal powder
